build_task_registry: build a task and tags registry from a ParlAI task list using _build
preprocess_task_name: preprocess a task name by lowercasing and removing hyphens using _preprocess
resolve_task_data: resolve task data or tag list from a task id using _id_to_task_data
resolve_task_id: resolve a task id or tag prefix to its canonical task name using _id_to_task
convert_ids_to_tasks: convert a comma-separated task ids string to resolved task names using ids_to_tasks
